div.head: Abt 14
div.ab: Gif wið eorles birele man geligeþ, XII scill' gebete.
Gif wið eorles birele man geligeþ, XII scill' gebete.
Gif wið eorles birele man geligeþ, XII scilƚ gebete.
Wenn bei eines Adligen Schenkin jemand liegt, büsse er [jenem] 12 Schill.
If someone lies with a nobleman’s cup-bearer [woman], let him pay [the latter] 12 shillings.
If a man lies with a nobleman’s serving maid, he shall pay 12 shillings compensation.
If anyone lies with a nobleman’s serving-woman, he is to pay 20 shillings compensation.
If a person lies with a nobleman’s cupbearer, let him pay 12 shillings.

note.seg: S. Gl Mundschenk 1. 2; o. 13³. — Nicht bloss die Unfreie, sondern die Frau eines gefolgsadligen Gutsbesitzers versieht das ministerium, dem Gaste offerre poculum und propinare ad prandium bei Beda V 4

See Gl Mundschenk 1. 2; above 13³. — Not only the unfree woman but also the wife of a landowner of the retinue-nobility performs the ministerium of offerre poculum to the guest and propinare ad prandium, in Bede V 4
